ti.title: ደቂ ቤትኪ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ብርሃንዩ ‘ቲ ስምኪ ዝመርሕ ናብ ጽድቂ
ርግኣት የስፍን ብእዋኑ ኣርሒቑ ንጭንቂ
ሕጉስ’ዩ ሕይወትና ኣዴና ምዃንኪ
ኣይሓፍርን’ዩ መጻኢና ዋሕስና እንዲኺ
ቤት ዶኪማስ መን ድዩ ኣትይዎ
እንከይሓፍር ጉድለቱ ሸፊንዎ
ተረኺብኪ ኣደይ ክንዲ ዅሉ ምስ ፍቑር ወድኺ
ስለዚ’ዩ ውሽጠይ ዝምካሕ ብኣኺ
[[/chorus]]

ደቂ ቤትኪ ዘሚሮም ንኽብርኺ (2)
ደቂ ጠቓዕትኺ ደኒኖም ኣብ ቅድሜኺ
ልቦም ኣሚኑ ወዲሶምኺ

ዘይኣምኑ ኣሚኖም ብሓይሊ ፍቕርኺ
እከይ ሓሳቦም ተበቲኑ ሰጊዶም ናባኺ
ግድን’ዩ ማርያም ኣደ እንዲኺ ኣደ
ብዘይብኣኺ’ዶ ካብ ሰማያት ምሕረት ምወረደ
ብጸጋኺ ሓጎስ ሰላም ኮይኑ
ቅዱስ ስምኪ ኣብ ኵሉ ገኒኑ
ዓለም ገሪምዋ ድንግል ማርያም ‘ቲ ዅሉ ውዕለትኪ
ንመድኃኔ ዓለም ጸዋሪት ምዃንኪ

ti_ro.title: Deqi betki
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Deqi betki zemirom nkhbrkhi (2)
[[/chorus]]

Deqi teqatkhi deninom ab qdmekhi
Lbom aminu wedisomkhi
Brhanyu ‘ti smki zmerh nab tsdqi
Rgat yesfn bwanu arhiqu nchnqi
Hgus’yu hywetna adena mkwanki
Ayhafrn’yu metsaina wahsna ndikhi
Bet dokimas men dyu atywo
Nkeyhafr gudletu shefinwo
Terekhibki adey kndi kwilu ms fqur wedkhi
Slezi’yu wshtey zmkah bakhi
Zeyamnu aminom bhayli fqrkhi
Key hasabom tebetinu segidom nabakhi
Gdn’yu maryam ade ndikhi ade
Bzeybakhi’do kab semayat mhret mwerede
Btsegakhi hagos selam koynu
Qdus smki ab kwilu geninu
Alem gerimwa dngl maryam ‘ti kwilu wletki
Nmedhane alem tsewarit mkwanki
Wegen nzeyblu ade tkhonyo
Ngodelo akal blgskhi mlat thbyo
Neti aremawi znq nsmki
Teli nay mhretki tefsslu gudletu shefinki
Ayterekhben maryam kemakhi
Kab fturan yelen zmesleki
Tsewarit melekot beza kwilu hyab qeranyo
Trfi ‘ti tsegakhi nabana afssyo
